name: Tamás G. Molnár
title: Assistant Professor
fitReason: Specific learning-enabled safety-filter methods executed on a real robot, with an active current safe-autonomy program.

physicalEvidence.status: Prior collaborative learned tracked-robot verified; current Cleveland execution unverified
physicalEvidence.summary: The complete ICRA 2024 paper deploys an LSTM/DNN classifier to infer driver intent and select among three backup controllers on a tracked GVR-Bot/modified PackBot510. ROS/Python/C++ control and depth-camera/IMU state estimation execute real obstacle avoidance; the human still supplies desired velocity commands. The learned switch operates inside analytical backup-CBF constraints, not a learned universal safety guarantee. Hardware is the Caltech/JPL collaboration while Molnar was at Wichita; present Cleveland platform access is unverified. Physical20.
